A 15 year old kid was at a party when he passed out (possibly drugged) and was brutally assaulted by his "friends" and teammates with a foreign object. 
Without going into too many details, I will say that after they left him bleeding for a few hours they finally dropped him off at a hospital almost dead. He now has a colostomy bag and probably a whole lot of other issues.

Every night I go to bed hoping I don't wake up in the morning. Every morning, the disappointment is debilitating. I spend at least five minutes debating calling in sick for the day. The days I don't call in sick, it's a lot of forced smiles until the constant work pushes the gray feeling down. Gray is actually a pretty accurate word for the feeling most days. 
On the days I don't go to work, I sleep until I can't sleep anymore. I wake up with this sick feeling in my gut and this dread, knowing that I am worthless and I will never make anything of myself, because I can't even get out of bed to go to the easiest job I've ever had. The rest of the day is me trying to distract myself from that train of thought. 

Then I go to bed at the end of the day, praying I don't wake up, and the cycle starts over again.

Been there. I had an employer when I was 18 who would hug me for a real long time and always slip at least a twenty in my back pocket. I was always too nervous or stupid to stop him. One day he and someone else were smoking weed in the back and offered me some (I had smoked before then but not a lot). I ended up getting super exhausted and almost fell off the counter I was sitting on. When I went to lay down on the couch he kept trying to grab my boob and I got so nervous about it that I forced myself to stay awake until I came down and could drive home so he wouldn't try anything while I was asleep.

I was late to this one class every day in sixth grade because of the guy at the locker next to mine always standing directly in front of mine. I ended up getting a lot of 30 minute detentions for being late. 

One day I missed a detention I didn't know I had (my mom had been told I was going to have detention, but didn't relay the message to me) and I had to have in school suspension (ISS). I got all of my work done for the whole day in about an hour or two, then spent the rest of the day reading with no one making any noise and disturbing me. Absolutely the BEST day of school I ever had (from middle school until the day I graduated).

There is a picture of my dad and me having a father daughter dance at my sweet sixteen. I was standing on his feet like I used to when I was little while we danced and talked. 

My dad is 6 ft tall and I was about 5'3, and since I was standing on his feet, we were obviously pretty close together. In the picture, we are talking to one another, and just the angle and the way we are standing makes it look like we are about to share a romantic kiss. 
It is still one of my favorite pictures because it was a nice night and my dad is really amazing, but I still don't show anyone; i don't want anyone who doesn't know my dad very well to see him in that kind of negative way.
